description: Short summary of a Wikipedia article in any language edition: title, one-paragraph extract, description, thumbnail and page URL. Use to ground an agent's answer in a quick, citable fact sheet. Example: title=Stockholm. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
